blocks.etymology: From Middle English unkyndely, from Old English unġecyndelīċe; equivalent to un- + kindly (adverb) or unkind + -ly.
vi_block: Một cách không tốt, một cách tàn nhẫn, một cách độc ác.

wiktionary.gloss: In an unkind manner.

examples: makings and unmakings of political alliances
wiktionary.gloss: The act by which something is unmade.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *n̥- From un- + photographed.

wiktionary.gloss: Not photographed (either on a specific occasion or ever)

thesaurus.definition: screen to keep insects from entering a building through the open window

wiktionary.gloss: A mesh, made of metal wire, fibreglass, or other synthetic fibre, set in a frame and covering the opening of a window to keep leaves, debris, insects, birds, etc. from entering a building without blocking fresh airflow.

blocks.etymology: Calque of Chinese 冬瓜 (dōngguā).

thesaurus.definition: any of a variety of muskmelon vines having fruit with a smooth white rind and white or greenish flesh that does not have a musky smell
the fruit of the winter melon vine; a green melon with pale green to orange flesh that keeps well

wiktionary.gloss: Benincasa hispida, a species of the gourd family (Cucurbitaceae) commonly cultivated in Asia.
Any late-maturing variety of true melon (Cucumis melo), such as honeydew melon (Inodorus Group), Cassaba melon (Cassaba Group), and Spanish melon (Ibericus Group).
